question: Why does Nelson (and multiplayer) Spelling on Workers Free hit Cloudflare Error 1102 / exceededCpu, and what is still open after H2–H4?

lockedRootCause.statement: Workers Free caps CPU at 10ms per request. Nelson spelling command cost under rapid successive submits sits near/above that budget and relies on isolate flexibility. Sustained burst (or overlapping multiplayer streams) withdraws flexibility → exceededCpu / HTML Error 1102 even when the failing invocation only records ~11–17ms CF CPU.
triggerShapes: Rapid sequential wrong→correct (+ continue) without human pacing
N≥2 concurrent spelling command streams once the isolate is stressed
Post-storm single requests while isolate is still exhausted (FC5)
nonTriggers: Human-paced submits with ≥~500ms gaps on a cool isolate (historically)
Thin/demo profiles under light load (lower d1RowsRead / CPU)

platformSignatures.http: Cloudflare HTML Error 1102 (often no x-ks2-request-id, no app JSON)
platformSignatures.paradox: Fail cpuTime can be lower than peer OK requests on the same scriptVersion (flexibility withdrawal)

falsified.claim: Request exceeds a hard ~50ms CPU budget because work is too expensive
falsified.whyFalse: Fail cpuTime often 11–17ms while OK peers reach 64–270ms on same scriptVersion

falsified.claim: CPU climbs across rounds until it crosses a threshold
falsified.whyFalse: Burst averages did not climb; failure is flexibility withdrawal, not monotonic climb
Concurrent same-revision → 409 stale_write locally; prod fail outcome is exceededCpu
Fail body is Cloudflare HTML 1102, not JSON projection_unavailable

falsified.claim: FC1 catalogue stale-stats scan is the only remaining cause
falsified.whyFalse: After FC1 fix, Nelson still exceededCpu with d1RowsRead p50≈60–62 (not ~1512)

classes.mechanism: stale/missing gameplay stats triggered full-catalogue json_each working-set

classes.symptom: Nelson wrong→correct → exceededCpu (burst and later paced500 regression on 6c6f6f4)

loadContributorsCut.what: release-bound catalogue fingerprint / pool cache / avoid O(words) walks
submit/continue working-set = active card only (not uniqueWords/results history)
loadContributorsCut.claimed: fat session ~51 item rows per submit
loadContributorsCut.caveat: post-H3 Nelson hammer still showed itemRows p50=51 and cpu p50=18ms; H3 may not have been the paced Nelson bottleneck

loadContributorsCut.what: memoize learner-visible spelling snapshot per isolate (WeakMap)
loadContributorsCut.result: paced/burst CF cpu p50=8ms on version 9c5533ea

cpu.note: wrangler tail session did not capture cpuTime join; do not treat CPU as independently re-verified

classes.whyStillOpen: H4 concurrent5 evidence is only 4 rounds / ~7s thin demo learners (d1RowsRead≈33–34), not fat Nelson-like free play. Pre-H4 longer concurrent5 paced-100ms had 503/1102.
classes.nextEvidence: longer concurrent-5 / true free-play soak with cooldown discipline + wrangler tail cpuTime join

classes.symptom: HTTP 400 demo_rate_limited after dense demo volume
After heavy hammers, even thin/paced traffic can 1102 until isolate recovers
classes.operatorRule: Keep multiplayer hammers short; cool down ≥2 minutes before remeasure

overallGoal.statement: Free-tier full game for 5 fat Nelson-like players playing freely
overallGoal.reason: FC2 single-player gates are conditionally green; FC3 longer multiplayer soak is still pending

reproduceNelsonPacedHttp.critical: Use bootstrap revision.selectedLearnerRevision — NOT learners.byId[id].stateRevision (missing on real accounts → expectedRevision 0 → all 409)

committedHammerBug.agentMethodLabel: nelson-api-client-sim-gap (label used in evidence; not present in committed hammer method string)
